environment.torch_blas: - LAPACK is enabled (usually provided by MKL); - Build settings: BLAS_INFO=mkl, BUILD_TYPE=Release, COMMIT_SHA=5c4886908584029761b579af026dcfb627c84070, CUDA_FLAGS= -DLIBCUDACXX_ENABLE_SIMPLIFIED_COMPLEX_OPERATIONS -Xfatbin -compress-all -DONNX_NAMESPACE=onnx_torch -gencode arch=compute_75,code=sm_75 -gencode arch=compute_80,code=sm_80 -gencode arch=compute_86,code=sm_86 -gencode arch=compute_90,code=sm_90 -gencode arch=compute_100,code=sm_100 -gencode arch=compute_120,code=sm_120 -Xcudafe --dia

analysis.c5_grid: w_g+w_b<=1, tie smaller w_g then w_b
analysis.rng_stream_order: c*, a*, then fraction-stratified c* (cohort A), then A-pub c* (cohort A only)

gate2_leaf_classes.path_semantics: leaf paths are key tuples, relative to one runs[i]; per_query rows are paired by their 'query' field
gate2_leaf_classes.skipped: binary_classification or ordinal_classification in P (threshold metrics not computed)
gate2_leaf_classes.identifier: fraction, seed exactly; checkpoint by its last two path components (the published JSON holds an absolute Mac path)
gate2_leaf_classes.exact: P[-1] in {selected_weight, n_queries} or queries_with_both_classes in P or confusion_matrix in P or (P[-1] == n and tier_stats in P); selected_weight has the near-tie exception (gap < 1e-4)
gate2_leaf_classes.rank: any of {validation_selection_curve, ranking, ranking_macro, per_query, global_auc, macro_query_auc} in P, or P[-1] in {kendall_tau_b, spearman_rho}

analysis.manifest_digest_rule: sha256 of sorted '<sha256>  <basename>\n' lines over chunk_*.npz
